extracted.name: Skillet Beef and Biscuit Pot Pie
extracted.description: I’m always looking for something to do with dinner leftovers being I still cook like all my family is still home plus I always like to have plenty of food just in case my kids friends are here unexpectedly!
ingredient_lines: Bag frozen vegetables corn, peas and green beans
2 cups shredded cooked beef I used leftover pot roast
1 can (16.3 oz) refrigerated Pillsbury™ biscuits or frozen biscuits thawed
instruction_lines: Heat oven to 375°F. In 12-inch ovenproof skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. Add onion, salt and pepper; cook 3 to 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until tender. Stir in veggies cook 12 to 16 minutes or until deep brown.
Stir in flour; cook 1 to 2 minutes or until thickened and beginning to brown.
Gradually stir in broth and milk; heat to simmering, stirring frequently. Cook 1 to 3 minutes longer, stirring frequently, until bubbly and thickened. Stir in brisket. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile separate dough into 8 biscuits. Cut each biscuit into fourths. Top brisket mixture with biscuit pieces.
Bake 23 to 27 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
